versions.changelog:
- Updated SKILL.md to increment the version to 1.7.1.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- No changes made to functionality, APIs, or workflow. All previous instructions and usage remain unchanged.

- Initial release of the skill enabling AI agents to send a single outbound email via Sendmux, strictly with human approval.
- Supports only one-message workflows; bulk and batch emailing are out of scope.
- Requires both message approval (exact recipients and content) and sending permission via an authorised Sendmux connection.
- Provides step-by-step usage guidance for preparing, sending, and reconciling idempotent email requests, including attachment handling and error cases.
- Ensures security by not sharing or requesting sensitive secrets in chat and delegating connection setup externally.
